definitions.explanation: The number 1,000 with {一|いち} stated. Where plain {千|せん} suffices in ordinary counting, {一千|いっせん} is used in formal writing and, above all, inside larger figures such as {一千万|いっせんまん} (10,000,000).

examples.japanese: {一千万|いっせんまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧。
⟦{被害額|ひがいがく}→被害額：30556_higaigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一千|いっせん}{億|おく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The damages reached one hundred billion yen.

examples.japanese: {一千|いっせん}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{読|よ}み{継|つ}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This work, written more than a thousand years ago, is still read today.

notes:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ shortens to いっ before ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧. Unlike ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧, where the ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ is obligatory, the ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ in {一千|いっせん} is optional — plain ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧ is the default in speech and everyday writing.

WHEN {一千|いっせん} IS PREFERRED:
- Inside larger figures: {一千万|いっせんまん} (10,000,000), {一千|いっせん}{億|おく} (100,000,000,000)
- Formal and journalistic writing, where the ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ makes the magnitude unmistakable
- Rhetorical spans of time: {一千|いっせん}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (a thousand years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧: one thousand yen — the everyday form; {一千|いっせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ would sound stilted
- {一千万|いっせんまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: ten million yen — here ⟦{千万|せんまん}→千万：28267_senman⟧ alone is not used
